demand.heading: Demand
demand.lede: One row per item: the total your customers are still waiting for, the earliest date any of them needs it, and what the transit zone already holds. Derived from customer orders on every read — never a stored list.

empty.heading: No customer is waiting for anything yet
empty.description: Record what a customer has asked for and it appears here, consolidated with everyone else waiting for the same item. The same is shown once every customer order is fulfilled or cancelled — those never count towards a demand line.

footer.note: Fulfilled and cancelled customer orders are not counted here.

coverageNote.heading: Covered by is what someone already ordered — not a reservation
coverageNote.body: A purchase draft linked to this demand is shown so you can see what a colleague has already ordered and for how much. It claims nothing: you may still draft the same demand again, and only goods that actually arrive reduce what a customer is waiting for.

customerOrder.typedName: Recorded by typed name — no delivery address
customerOrder.withheldName: a customer you may not see

record.title: Record what a customer is waiting for
record.description: The order is recorded against this warehouse and joins the consolidated demand immediately.
record.customerNameHelp: The end customer waiting for the goods, typed by hand. No customer is created or matched for it.
record.itemHelp: Only active items of this warehouse are offered.
record.quantityHelp: A whole number greater than zero, counted in the unit the item is counted in.
record.neededByHelp: A date that has not already passed.

refusal.invalid: Nothing was recorded. Correct the values this warehouse will not accept and try again.
refusal.unavailable: Nothing was recorded. That item is not one this warehouse offers.
refusal.invalidDeliveryAddress: Nothing was recorded. Choose one of that customer’s active delivery addresses and try again.

record.customerHelp: Choose a customer of this warehouse to record the order against them and their delivery address. Leave it empty to type a name instead.
record.customerNameSupersededHelp: Not used while a customer is chosen — the order is recorded against that customer.

amend.title: Amend {{customerName}}'s order
amend.description: Consolidated demand reflects the change on the next read.
amend.quantityHelp: A whole number greater than zero, counted in the unit the item is counted in.
amend.neededByHelp: A date that has not already passed.

frozenDrafts.heading: A frozen draft linked to this order will report a drift signal
frozenDrafts.body: No frozen draft changes — each one records what the supplier was told. What moves is the comparison against the demand captured when it was made ready. A value amended and then put back as it was stops being reported.

refusal.invalid: Nothing was changed. Change the quantity or the needed-by date before saving.
refusal.unavailable: Nothing was changed. That customer order is no longer available.
refusal.invalidState: Nothing was changed. This order has already been fulfilled or cancelled.
refusal.invalidDeliveryAddress: Nothing was changed. Choose one of that customer’s active delivery addresses and try again.

cancel.title: Cancel {{customerName}}'s order?
cancel.description: It leaves the consolidated demand and stops counting anywhere.
cancel.reasonHelp: Recorded with your name and the time.
cancel.frozenDrafts: A frozen draft that links to this order keeps every value it was frozen with and reports a drift signal instead.

refusal.invalid: Nothing was cancelled. State a reason and try again.
refusal.unavailable: Nothing was cancelled. That customer order is no longer available.
refusal.invalidState: Nothing was cancelled. This order has already been fulfilled or cancelled.
refusal.invalidDeliveryAddress: Nothing was cancelled. That customer order names a delivery address this warehouse will not accept.

redirect.title: Redirect {{customerName}}'s order
redirect.description: The order stays with the same customer and keeps counting in the consolidated demand exactly as before.

drift.heading: A frozen draft linked to this order will report address drift
drift.body: No frozen draft changes — each one records the address the supplier was told. What moves is the comparison against where this order now goes. Redirecting it back to the frozen address stops the report.

refusal.invalid: Nothing was changed. Choose one of this customer’s active delivery addresses and try again.
refusal.unavailable: Nothing was changed. That customer order is no longer available.
refusal.invalidState: Nothing was changed. Only an outstanding customer order is redirected.
refusal.invalidDeliveryAddress: Nothing was changed. An outstanding customer order is redirected only to another active delivery address of the customer it already names — serving a different customer means recording a new customer order.
